name: Use NTFS Short Name in Image
description: Detect use of the Windows 8.3 short name. Which could be used as a method to avoid Image based detection
author: GAI_CTI
query: (process.executable:(*\~1.bat* OR *\~1.dll* OR *\~1.exe* OR *\~1.hta* OR *\~1.js* OR *\~1.msi* OR *\~1.ps1* OR *\~1.tmp* OR *\~1.vbe* OR *\~1.vbs* OR *\~2.bat* OR *\~2.dll* OR *\~2.exe* OR *\~2.hta* OR *\~2.js* OR *\~2.msi* OR *\~2.ps1* OR *\~2.tmp* OR *\~2.vbe* OR *\~2.vbs*)) AND (NOT process.parent.executable:C\:\\Windows\\explorer.exe) AND (NOT (process.parent.executable:*\\WebEx\\WebexHost.exe OR process.parent.executable:*\\thor\\thor64.exe OR process.executable:C\:\\PROGRA\~1\\WinZip\\WZPREL\~1.EXE OR process.executable:*\\VCREDI\~1.EXE))
